column1: =每天一點，日積月累。這是一個陪你專注、推進長期計畫、照顧身心的練習空間。接下來用幾張卡片，帶你認識最重要的用法。
column2: A little every day adds up. This is a space to help you focus, move long projects forward and look after yourself. The next few cards show you the most important parts.

column1: =寫下今天最重要的三件事，按下番茄鐘開始專注。暫停時可以記下停在哪裡；冒出雜念就丟進「雜念停車場」。每段結束花十秒記下做了什麼，月曆和統計會自動累積。
column2: Write down today’s three most important things and start the Pomodoro timer. When you pause, note where you stopped; when a stray thought pops up, drop it in the “Distraction parking lot”. After each session, take ten seconds to log what you did — the calendar and stats add it up for you.

column1: =建立專案後，會依完成日排好階段和小步驟，每天只要做「最小的一步」。「會談」可以預約指導教授（直接在 Google 日曆確認後送出），會談結束後自動跳出紀錄表，老師的建議會變成待辦。
column2: Create a project and it is laid out into stages and small steps up to your due date — each day you only need the “smallest next step”. Under “Meetings” you can book your advisor (you confirm and send it in Google Calendar); when the meeting ends, a notes form pops up and your advisor’s suggestions become to-dos.

column1: =「我的節奏」用大約 12 分鐘的問答，找出你一天中的精力高峰和低谷，以及最能推動你的動力，排出建議的一天。可以分段做，每段完成都會先給你結果。
column2: “My rhythm” is a 12-minute questionnaire that finds your daily energy peak and dip and what motivates you most, then suggests a plan for your day. You can do it in parts — each part shows you its results right away.

column1: =到「設定」可以決定要顯示哪些頁面（用不到的先藏起來，資料都會保留），也能調整字體大小、畫面縮放、鈴聲音量，以及螢幕關掉時是否仍要響鈴。
column2: In “Settings” you choose which pages to show (hide what you don’t need — your data is kept), and adjust text size, zoom, alarm volume, and whether the alarm still rings when the screen is off.

column1: =紀錄存在你自己的私人空間，換裝置登入同一個帳號就能接著用。分享這個頁面給別人，他們也看不到你的資料。
column2: Your records are kept in your own private space; sign in with the same account on another device to pick up where you left off. If you share this page, others still can’t see your data.

column2: Your records are saved on this device first. Go to “Settings → Data protection & sync” and sign in with Google, and your phone and computer stay in sync automatically — which also means you always have a cloud backup. We recommend adding Daily Practice to your phone’s home screen.
